title: Olive's Big Job
checkpoint: Phase 1 (Introduction) — a wordless story for sharing and talking through together; there are no sounds to decode yet.
note_for_grown_ups: A story about asking for help with a job that is too big to do alone — a good one to talk about teamwork and when it is sensible to ask a friend.

pages.talk_prompt: Olive is trying to push a big log by herself — is it working?
pages.illustration: Olive the owl straining to push a large log on top of the compost heap by herself, the log not moving.

pages.talk_prompt: Olive has stopped pushing — what do you think she is going to do now?
pages.illustration: Olive the owl stepping back from the large log, looking around the garden for help.

pages.talk_prompt: Olive is calling someone over — who do you think is coming to help?
pages.illustration: Olive the owl waving a wing to call Moss the hedgehog over towards the compost heap.

pages.talk_prompt: Now there are two of them pushing — do you think that will make a difference?
pages.illustration: Olive the owl and Moss the hedgehog pushing the large log together from opposite sides on the compost heap.

pages.talk_prompt: The log is tipping over — what do you think they will find underneath?
pages.illustration: The large log tipping over on the compost heap as Olive the owl and Moss the hedgehog watch closely.

pages.talk_prompt: Look what was hiding under the log — how do you think Olive and Moss feel about doing the job together?
pages.illustration: Olive the owl and Moss the hedgehog looking happily into a cosy hollow under the moved log, pleased with their teamwork.
